public.text: Optional services are tested only when a system declares support. This may permit suppliers to avoid testing important recommended functions by not declaring them.
public.suggestedRevision: Require procurement specifications to identify which optional or recommended capabilities are mandatory for the national use case. Conformance statements must explicitly list unsupported optional capabilities.
